online.provenance: Fresh real online process from capture attempt 2; raw audit/log/syscalls revalidated after correcting only syscall classification, no online cache reuse or rerun

syscalls.scope: strace -f captures network syscalls of traced process and children

protected_source_check_scope: Source fingerprints freeze before fresh offline continuation through finish; local history and base/local configs also match earlier Phase 3 gate

excluded_result_fields.backtest_run_start_ts: Wall-clock process start time, unrelated to historical decisions
excluded_result_fields.backtest_run_end_ts: Wall-clock process end time, unrelated to historical decisions

comparison_policy.metadata_normalization: Validate data_path suffix against artifact parent; normalize only independent userdir root
comparison_policy.metadata_fields: All fields, including unknown/extra fields, are compared
comparison_policy.configuration: All exported fields including exchange/FreqAI; config_files only normalizes checkout root, preserving order
comparison_policy.nonfinite: Reject non-finite JSON and frame infinities; paired frame NaN masks must match

publication.redaction_scope: Only local filesystem roots in UTF-8 logs/JSON/ZIP config; binary signals and predictions unchanged
publication.raw_files: Retained only in local ephemeral workspace; never required for rerunning acceptance
